title: autofarm
features:
auto collect eggs
auto deposit
auto collect money
script:
function ok(x)
firetouchinterest(game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart, x, 1)
firetouchinterest(game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart, x, 0)
end

function collect()
for i,v in ipairs(workspace.Eggs:GetDescendants()) do
if v.Name == "Part" then
ok(v)
end
end
end

a=game:service'ReplicatedStorage'.Paper.Remotes["__remotefunction"]
while true do
task.wait(0.1)
collect()
a:InvokeServer("Deposit Eggs")
a:InvokeServer("Collect Cash")
end
